design.changedWorldCondition: load is multiplied by 1.2 from hour 48; tariff, ESS, and all other settings remain fixed
design.primaryOutcome: (stress-chain - stress-base) - (normal-chain - normal-base); positive means load stress increases chain cost relative to base
design.seedSelection: independent 256-bit labels from node:crypto.randomBytes; sample distribution is induced by the current seed initializer, not asserted uniform over uint32 states
design.treatmentOrder: randomized independently within each seed using node:crypto.randomInt; every cell starts from a fresh Lab with the same seed label
design.stateSelection: record STEP.rngBefore.state and reject only repeated initial states across seeds; repeated action traces remain valid coverage observations
design.interval: approximate two-sided 95% paired Student-t interval for same-seed interaction, df=19; difference normality is not established
design.objectiveOracle: STEP action token + independently encoded stressed load + public static TOU tariff; adapter settlement totals are not used
